title: Displacement structure and eigenvalue bounds for multiband prolate matrices
summary: We obtain explicit non-asymptotic bounds for the eigenvalue transition of multiband prolate matrices. Let $S\subset[-1/2,1/2]$ be a finite union of pairwise disjoint intervals, and let $λ_0\ge\cdots\geλ_{N-1}$ be the eigenvalues of $B_{N,S}$. If $ν$ is the number of boundary points of $S$ on the frequency torus, then, for every $0<\eps<1/2$, \[ \#\{k:\eps<λ_k<1-\eps\} \le ν\ceil{\frac{\log(4N)}{π^2} \log\!\left(\frac{4}{\eps(1-\eps)}\right)}. \] Compared with the multiband estimate of Zhu and Wakin~\cite{wakin2017approximating}, this improves the dependence on $\eps$ from order…
